question: Should Control UI add a dedicated expanded composer modal for long prompts, or should the current inline autogrow textarea plus configurable send shortcut remain the intended solution?
rationale: The requested modal is plausible and aligned with web-frontend ergonomics, but it introduces a second composition mode with product-sensitive draft, attachment, focus, and send semantics.

options.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
options.body: Build a bounded Control UI modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

options.title: Prefer Inline Composer
options.body: Treat the current autogrow textarea plus modifier-send setting as the intended long-prompt path and close or narrow this request.

options.title: Defer UX Mode Choice
options.body: Keep this open but out of automated fix intake until a Control UI owner chooses the editor shape.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Expanded Composer
recommendation.body: Build a bounded Control UI modal editor with separate draft state, Apply, Cancel/Close, Send, focus restoration, and inline-versus-modal keyboard tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest adjacent send-shortcut ownership and prior review context for this issue.
